text: dsh-skill-studio 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的技能工作台，同时提供 agent 工具和会话提取能力。它扫描项目与用户技能目录，并合并 DSH 注册表中的运行时技能；用户可查看技能正文、编辑有文件路径的技能，并分别控制模型和用户调用。工作台还可扫描近期会话日志，经配置的 LLM 生成待审核候选，供用户编辑、接受或拒绝，接受后写入 agent 技能目录。适合希望集中维护 DSH 技能、整理可复用会话经验的用户。会话提取需配置兼容的 LLM 服务。

dsh-skill-studio is a DSH web workspace to browse and edit skills, change invocation settings, and manage skill drafts extracted from recent sessions. It merges file and registry skills; accepted LLM drafts are saved to the agent skill directory.
想在 DSH 网页里集中查看项目和个人的技能文件。

让 DSH 帮我从最近的会话记录整理出可复用技能草稿。
我需要先检查候选技能，再决定接受还是丢弃。
希望把常用技能按分组浏览，并识别嵌套技能来自哪里。
I want to review and manage my DSH skill files from the web settings page.
Can I turn recent session notes into reusable skill drafts for approval?
dsh-skill-studio 的功能「技能目录与详情」：合并文件系统扫描结果和 DSH 注册表技能，列出来源、调用状态与分组，并可打开正文。通过 Web 工作台或 skillmgr_list、skillmgr_get 使用。
dsh-skill-studio 的功能「编辑与调用策略」：对有文件路径的技能保存全文，并可统一或分别调整模型、用户调用开关。用户在面板操作或调用 skillmgr_save、skillmgr_policy。
dsh-skill-studio 的功能「会话提取候选」：按配置扫描近期会话日志并调用 LLM 生成去重后的技能草稿，放入待确认队列。可查看、编辑、接受或拒绝候选；接受后写入 agent 技能目录。
dsh-skill-studio 的功能「嵌套技能发现」：扫描标准技能目录及配置的额外目录，并展开一层包含子技能的目录。列表标注嵌套状态和父级名称，便于在工作台辨认来源。
dsh-skill-studio 使用前须知：会话提取需要配置兼容 LLM；提取过程会把会话摘要提交给所配置的服务生成草稿，面板默认服务地址为 api.deepseek.com。

dsh-skill-studio README · dsh-skill-studio：> **English** | [**中文**](README.zh.md)

Visualize, edit and manage DeepSeek Harness **skills** right from the web settings panel — list every skill DSH discovered, view its full `SKILL.md`, edit the body, and enable/disable model & user invocation with a switch.

dsh-skill-studio README · Features：- **Skill 管理器 settings panel** — 设置 → Skill 管理器: list every skill (name, description, source root, nested flag, model/user invocation state), open any skill to see its full body, edit the `SKILL.md` file in place, and toggle enable / model-invocable / user-invocable.
- **skillmgr_list** — list all skills with source, nested flag and invocation state.
- **skillmgr_get** — view one skill's full detail (body + path + policy).
- **skillmgr_save** — save a full-body edit (frontmatter + markdown) back to the file.
- **skillmgr_policy** — enable/disable a skill (`enabled` master switch, or per-interface `modelInvocable` / `userInvocable`).
- **Two merged catalogs**: ① direct filesystem scan of the standard roots (project `.dsh/skills` / `.agents/skills`, user `~/.dsh/skills` / `~/.agents/skills`), expanding one level of nested bundles (e.g. `~/.agents/skills/superpowers/<name>` — flagged 嵌套/nested), plus ② the official registry (`ctx.skills`) for runtime / bundled skills. The panel therefore shows every skill on disk even when the host-plane filesystem provider is disabled (the web architecture deliberately moves local discovery to per-agent presets).

dsh-skill-studio README · Notes：- The frontmatter `name` key must match the skill name (kebab-case); breaking the frontmatter format may cause DSH to skip the skill on rediscovery.
- Editing is scoped to files the skill registry reports; the plugin never accepts arbitrary paths.
- Zero runtime dependencies beyond the DSH peer packages.
